g.text: To assess sampling effects on apparent clonal expansion, older mice retain higher T-cell clonality after standardizing to 60 reconstructed
cells. Tissue sampling and reconstruction remain alternative explanations; clonality does not measure immune function. B–D: mouse points
and means; sex is not encoded.
